description: Resource Type definition for AWS::S3Vectors::Index. Source:- https://github.com/aws-cloudformation/aws-cloudformation-rpdk.git

CreationTime.description: Date and time when the vector index was created.
CreationTime.title: AWSS3VectorsIndexCreationTimeDefinition

DataType.description: The data type of the vectors to be inserted into the vector index.
DataType.title: AWSS3VectorsIndexDataTypeDefinition

Dimension.description: The dimensions of the vectors to be inserted into the vector index.
Dimension.title: AWSS3VectorsIndexDimensionDefinition

DistanceMetric.description: The distance metric to be used for similarity search.
DistanceMetric.title: AWSS3VectorsIndexDistanceMetricDefinition

EncryptionConfiguration.description: The encryption configuration for the index.

SseType.description: Defines the server-side encryption type for index encryption configuration. Defaults to the parent vector bucket's encryption settings when unspecified.

KmsKeyArn.description: AWS Key Management Service (KMS) customer managed key ID to use for the encryption configuration. This parameter is allowed if and only if sseType is set to aws:kms

EncryptionConfiguration.title: AWSS3VectorsIndexEncryptionConfigurationDefinition

IndexArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the index
IndexArn.title: AWSS3VectorsIndexIndexArnDefinition

IndexName.description: The name of the vector index to create.
IndexName.title: AWSS3VectorsIndexIndexNameDefinition

MetadataConfiguration.description: The metadata configuration for the vector index.

NonFilterableMetadataKeys.description: Non-filterable metadata keys allow you to enrich vectors with additional context during storage and retrieval. Unlike default metadata keys, these keys cannot be used as query filters. Non-filterable metadata keys can be retrieved but cannot be searched, queried, or filtered. You can access non-filterable metadata keys of your vectors after finding the vectors.

MetadataConfiguration.title: AWSS3VectorsIndexMetadataConfigurationDefinition

VectorBucketArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the vector bucket.
VectorBucketArn.title: AWSS3VectorsIndexVectorBucketArnDefinition

VectorBucketName.description: The name of the vector bucket that contains the vector index.
VectorBucketName.title: AWSS3VectorsIndexVectorBucketNameDefinition

Key.description: Tag key must be between 1 to 128 characters in length. Tag key cannot start with 'aws:' and can only contain alphanumeric characters, spaces, _, ., /, =, +, -, and @.

Value.description: Tag value must be between 0 to 256 characters in length. Tag value can only contain alphanumeric characters, spaces, _, ., /, =, +, -, and @.

Tags.description: User tags (key-value pairs) to associate with the index.

title: AWSS3VectorsIndexProperties
